Khalifa and Dean Mahmoud criticize sectarian Shafi'i laws in Southeast Asia that disinherit non-Muslim or adopted children, citing Sura 33:5 to argue that adopted children must be treated equally to biological offspring. Dean Mahmoud recounts a story from the Philippines of a wealthy Muslim who gifted his estate to his adopted Christian son while alive to circumvent hostile relatives. The session concludes with Khalifa leading the recitation of Al-Fatihah.
